name: com.longleap.gamepix
description: GamePix portal backend: ads (interstitial, rewarded, score), portal language, Xsolla ID sign-in through the portal SDK, and editor tooling (GamePix menu, Build Manager options and build target, index.html postprocess, HTML5 zip packager). Requires the GamePix Unity plugin at Assets/Plugins/GamePix and the GAMEPIX scripting define.
